questions.stem: In the cloning of Dolly the sheep, which cell provided the nucleus?

options.text: A stem cell from a lamb
An adult body cell (udder cell) from the sheep to be cloned
An egg cell from a different sheep

questions.explanation: The nucleus was taken from an adult udder (body) cell of the sheep to be cloned. This nucleus contained the full set of DNA and was inserted into an enucleated egg cell from a different sheep.
